name: sharqia-mes-mobile
description: بيت العباءة الشرقية MES — MES mobile app (Capacitor shell over the existing web UI, with an Odoo-ready data/service layer). No backend or demo server is bundled.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
